source: DBForge Supabase schema unification TAC route

nodes.label: Operator Goal
nodes.summary: Turn the schema cleanup plan into a TAC-governed PRD and report package.

nodes.label: TAC Supervisor
nodes.summary: Routes PRD, repair, validation, and apply gates.

nodes.label: PRD Agent
nodes.summary: Converts the schema plan into approved PRD sections.

nodes.label: DBForge Scan Agent
nodes.summary: Scanned live schema, RLS, migration ledger, status vocabulary, and storage metadata.

nodes.label: Report Agent
nodes.summary: Produces PRD, build readiness report, DAG report, SVG hyperframes, and email body.

nodes.label: Migration Repair Agent
nodes.summary: Repairs the pending migration and adds status-map/view-security gates.

nodes.label: SQL Static Check
nodes.summary: Confirms no missing table references and checks idempotent SQL shape.

nodes.label: Branch/Local Validation
nodes.summary: Runs migration against local or branch database where available.

nodes.label: Production DDL Gate
nodes.summary: Production apply waits for explicit operator approval after validation.

nodes.label: Readback Receipt
nodes.summary: Records object existence, RLS/policies, view counts, and status-map coverage.
